name: Hammer, Pearl and Coin (Chùy Châu Tiền)

bonuses.effect: Going Once, Going Twice (Nhất Phách Nhị Phách)
bonuses.rule: when Hammer Price spends ten or more Metal stacks, you keep a third of them; the Coin's Bought Fate is paid from the ward the Seal has taken from the foe instead of from your spirit stones, and may flip twice a fight; and while you still hold such a ward, the Pearl's saving of a killing blow is ready once more, spending that ward instead of cracking.

story: The auction's seal, the pearl grown in her and the coin that buys fate. Phan Vật Hoa holds all three. The coin is a catalogue piece (general-heaven-purchasing-coin) with no set field of its own; this set names it as the third piece, and her master's Mirror of the Third Price stays in her keeping, unworn. A set that cannot be sold is the studio's only joke.

name: The Xích Kim Furnace (Xích Kim Lô Cụ)

bonuses.effect: Fights With What He Made (Dĩ Sở Tạo Chiến)
bonuses.rule: when you block with the Lid, the Sword's next strike comes hot from the furnace: it deals 30 % more, ignores 20 % of the target's defence and adds 2 Metal stacks.

story: Three generations' apron, the lid he cracked and the sword he would not sell. Khang Thiên Chùy holds all three, and they are the one set in Thiên Bảo Trai that has never been in the auction book.
